summary: Brookfield Business Corporation filed a Form 6-K with a press release announcing the TSX accepted its notice to renew its normal course issuer bid for class A subordinate voting shares. The issuer is authorized to buy back up to 10,272,100 shares, representing 5% of the 205,442,014 shares outstanding as of August 7, 2026. Purchases begin August 19, 2026 and end August 18, 2027, subject to a 33,379-share daily limit (25% of average daily volume). The prior bid repurchased the maximum 3,499,836 shares at a weighted average price of US$32.98 per share. The buyback will occur on the TSX and NYSE, and all purchased shares will be cancelled. An automatic share purchase plan allows purchases during blackout periods. What to watch: the pace of buybacks and share price reaction relative to the issuer's stated undervaluation view.
